decision.rationale: A prior whose 3 px halo already covers the entire allowed domain returns forward overlap 1.0 for every possible candidate, so the literal dot test is constant and carries no information about lane drift; the protocol's rank-correlation test is the one defined for such a surface. For every prior that can discriminate, the same 0.70 limit is applied to the chance-corrected excess, which equals the literal overlap when the prior has no halo advantage and is stricter in relative terms otherwise.
